name: docs prune worklist
description: Candidates with reasons: broken anchor/claim/path, changed anchor body, orphaned (when matches no files), unread for N days per kind policy, plan entries of shipped features (convert to decision/fact or delete), deprecated features with orphaned paths, collapsible steps with all issues done. --json worklist for agents.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged 073bf21. docs prune [--json] [-r code]... [-f id] [--today] is read-only and always exits 0. Codes, strongest first: DeprecatedOrphan, Orphaned (every path dead and every anchor broken; keywords alone never orphan), BrokenAnchor, ChangedAnchor, DeadPath, ShippedPlan, Unread, CollapsibleStep. Unread uses last seen = the latest of read/updated/created, so docs touch clears it. DocsInspection.Run is the shared pass behind check and prune (HintSite, SiteInspection, PlanInspection), and RepoPaths.Exists fixes DeadPath for globs. Follow-up: DocsPruner.Suggest still prints a literal 'docs edit <address> ...'; now that #40 has landed it could name concrete flags (e.g. --add-anchor to re-anchor or accept a changed hash, -k decision).
